ENGLISH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 2.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling.

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.2 Conversational Skills: fluency in speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.2 Conversational Skills: fluency in speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.2 Conversational Skills: fluency in speaking.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.2 Conversational Skills: fluency in speaking.

3. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)

====

1. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.4.1 Mechanics of Writing: Spelling.

2. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.2 Conversational Skills: fluency in speaking.

3. A — A person, place, thing, or idea

4. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency.

5. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.2 Speaking: Etiquette.

6. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Extensive Reading.

7. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Verbs Main and Auxiliary Verbs, Tense and Asp.

8. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening.

9. B — run

10. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1 Extensive Listening.

11. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.5.1 Sentence Fluency.

12. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word Classes.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Grammar in Use 8.3.1 Clause Patterns; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Sentence types; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Writing 8.4.1 Argumentative and Expository Writing; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Listening and Speaking 9.1.1 Selective Listening; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
